title: SCP-148, Telekill
description: An anomalous alloy that grants immense power at the cost of instability.
body:
Telekill adds a new ore. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-148, also known as Telekill.


This material can be found deep underground and can be refined into powerful tools, weapons, and armor.
SCP-148 equipment offers extreme performance and unique protective properties, but it cannot be enchanted with enchanting tables and behaves unpredictably when used. While highly effective, Telekill items are unstable, forcing players to carefully choose when and how they are used.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-148 generate?

SCP-148 generates as an ore within the y-level 10 to -64 in the overworld. It's a rare material and needs netherite pickaxes to be harvested.

</details>



![SCP-148](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8359d7f487ec474f8ebae0c9096f4145127c467.png)

SCP-148, also known as Telekill Alloy, is an anomalous metal. It naturally generates as an rare ore between Y-levels 10 to -64 and can only be mined using a Netherite Pickaxe, taking a long time to break. The Telekill Ore can be put into a blast furnace to smelt it into Telekill Scraps. You will then need 2 Telekill Scraps, 2 diamonds, 2 iron ingots, 2 copper ingots and 1 netherite scrap to craft it into one Telekill Ingots, which is used to upgrade Netherite equipment and shields through a smithing table, or craft Telekill Blocks. Telekill tools have high efficiency and possess very high harvest levels, but rapidly degrade when used against mobs or sometimes even give a bad effect for a very short time while using the tool. The Telekill sword deals 80 damage, often killing creatures in a single strike, but have very limited durability and could even break into SCP-1023-ARC, the broken Telekill Sword which directly kills everything. when the durability of the Telekill Sword is below 100. Telekill Shields have a lower durability than the other Telekill Equipment, but it damages attacker mobs. Telekill armor provides strong protection and prevents Piglin aggression and some negative effects. While all Telekill Equipment can be repaired, except the SCP-1023-ARC, it is very hard to obtain.
